content:
**High Voltage Hefe** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

High Voltage Hefe is an alcoholic beverage which uses the energy-based fusion cell for the "high voltage" part of the brew's name.

Similar to other fermentable beverages, High Voltage Hefe is initially crafted as fermentable High Voltage Hefe, offering no benefits and having a significantly high disease chance of 9% until fully fermented. It shares its model with the regular unlabeled beer. High Voltage Hefe can be crafted using the brewing and distilling functionality of *Wild Appalachia*.

High Voltage Hefe affects all non-heavy energy weapons and their unique variants.
